recentItems.title: Bidar SP Pradeep Gunti, IPS Exclusive Interview | Crime Diaries With Muralidhar #741 | iDream
recentItems.description:
#Muralidhar
 #idreamnews #idreamupdates #idreammediainterviews #teluguinterviews 

In this exclusive interview, SP Pradeep Gunti (2016 Batch IPS, Bidar, Karnataka) reveals the gripping, behind-the-scenes details of one of India’s most challenging interstate police operations—tracking down the notorious Bihar gang responsible for the January 2025 Bidar ₹83 Lakh SBI ATM Robbery & Firing, the Hyderabad Afzalgunj firing, and the 2023 UP Mirzapur bank heist.

Discover how a team of Karnataka police officers went undercover as "solar company workers" and temple devotees in Bihar's Vaishali district for 18 months without revealing their identities, survived a mob attack in Damodarpur, and drove 27 hours non-stop to bring the culprits to justice.

Key Highlights of this Interview:

The Bidar & Hyderabad Firing Case: How the shooters evaded toll gates using internal roads and escaped to Hyderabad, Tirupati, and Bihar.

The 18-Month Undercover Hunt: Living in rented houses in Bihar, tracking the gang without phone signals, and the single mistake (illicit liquor) that led to their capture.

Mob Attack & Survival: How local villagers mistook the undercover cops for kidnappers and attacked them during the arrest.

High-Tech Policing & Irani Gang: How Bidar's AI-powered Command Control Center tracks habitual offenders and the notorious Irani Gang in seconds.

The Mysuru Gang Rape Case: How a single torn bus ticket from Tamil Nadu helped crack a blind case with zero CCTV clues.

Cyber Crime & Digital Arrests: Why educated people fall for scams and how greed plays a major role.

#PradeepGuntiIPS #BidarSP #RealLifeSingham #IndianPolice #CrimeInvestigation #BidarATMRobbery #TeluguIPS #TrueCrimeIndia #PoliceInterview #BiharGang #IraniGang #CyberCrimeAwareness
